$ container --version
container CLI version 1.5.0

# Taken 2026-10-19 by asking the runtime directly, on alpine:latest, with a bind mount of a directory
# holding an executable file that has no `#!` line (`echo hi`, mode +x) and that file as the command.
# The kernel answers ENOEXEC (`Code=8`) for it as it does for a binary of another architecture, so
# the wording is the same one; an amd64 binary in an arm64 image was not built here. After either run
# `container ls -a` listed no container of that name: the failed start leaves nothing behind.

$ container run -d --name neko-enoexec-1 -v <dir>:/t alpine:latest /t/noshebang
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[1/6] Fetching image [0s]
[2/6] Unpacking image [0s]
[3/6] Fetching kernel [0s]
[4/6] Fetching init image [0s]
[5/6] Unpacking init image [0s]
[6/6] Starting container [0s]
[6/6] Starting container [0s]
Error: failed to start process neko-enoexec-1 in container neko-enoexec-1 (cause: "internalError: "failed to start process (cause: "internalError: "startProcess: failed to start process: internalError: "vmexec error: internalError: "failed to exec [/t/noshebang] Error Domain=NSPOSIXErrorDomain Code=8 "Exec format error""""")"")

$ container run --name neko-enoexec-1 -v <dir>:/t alpine:latest /t/noshebang
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[1/6] Fetching image [0s]
[2/6] Unpacking image [0s]
[3/6] Fetching kernel [0s]
[4/6] Fetching init image [0s]
[5/6] Unpacking init image [0s]
[6/6] Starting container [0s]
[6/6] Starting container [0s]
Error: failed to exec [/t/noshebang] Error Domain=NSPOSIXErrorDomain Code=8 "Exec format error"
Error: failed to start process neko-enoexec-1 in container neko-enoexec-1 (cause: "internalError: "failed to start process (cause: "internalError: "startProcess: failed to start process: internalError: "vmexec error: internalError: "failed to exec [/t/noshebang] Error Domain=NSPOSIXErrorDomain Code=8 "Exec format error""""")"")

# Taken 2026-10-19, a second run of the same two commands under another name, asking `container ls -a` after each
# (a header row and no row naming the container: the failed start leaves nothing behind).

$ container run -d --name neko-enoexec-2 -v <dir>:/t alpine:latest /t/noshebang   # exit 1
$ container ls -a   # after the detached run (rows naming neko-enoexec-2)
ID        IMAGE                                                OS     ARCH   STATE    IP               CPUS  MEMORY   STARTED
(rows: 0)
$ container run --name neko-enoexec-2 -v <dir>:/t alpine:latest /t/noshebang   # exit 1   (the same name again: not 'already exists')
$ container ls -a   # after the foreground run
ID        IMAGE                                                OS     ARCH   STATE    IP               CPUS  MEMORY   STARTED
(rows: 0)
